title: EVALUATING & REDUCING DECEPTIVE DIALOGUE FROM LANGUAGE MODELS WITH MULTI-TURN RL
reasoning: The paper is dedicated to evaluating and reducing deception in LLMs, which is a fundamental concern in AI ethics and morals. It utilizes philosophical and psychological frameworks to define deception (referencing figures like Immanuel Kant) and establishes a benchmarking methodology to measure and improve the ethical behavior of models in conversational settings.
